scope: Build ordinary and independently reviewed direct-proof packages twice; verify exact one-word adapters and receipts; remove author sources; install prepared npm archives offline; execute and relocate Node JavaScript and strict TypeScript consumers; and run browser JavaScript, React and dedicated Workers through all three engines and their complete failure/lifecycle phases.

edits.current:
- name: Require direct proof erasure in Node, TypeScript and three browsers
        id: direct_proof_npm
        timeout-minutes: 60
        env:
          LEAN_BRIDGE_LAKE_ENGINE: build/locked-lake-engine/bin/lean-bridge-component-engine
          LEAN_BRIDGE_LAKE_RUNTIME_ROOT: build/consumer-ci-runtime/lazy
        run: bash scripts/run-direct-proof-erasure-npm-ci.sh
      - name: Preserve direct proof-erasure npm and browser records
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: direct-proof-erasure-node-browser-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/direct-proof-erasure-npm-ci/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

          executed="${{ steps.consumer.outcome == 'success' && steps.type_corpus_npm.outcome == 'success' && steps.reviewed_fin_npm.outcome == 'success' && steps.reviewed_subtype_npm.outcome == 'success' && steps.structural_subtype_npm.outcome == 'success' && steps.direct_proof_npm.outcome == 'success' && steps.dependent_fin_npm.outcome == 'success' && 'true' || 'false' }}"
